result.title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees
result.summary: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent, and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.

AI.brief_summary: TreeFlex 让 agent 自身策略在 harness 维护的搜索树上导航：模型分 Reflection 与 Execution 两个角色，自主决定深化、分支、回溯、验证或停止，并用树感知的 GRPO 联合训练导航、任务动作、检查点与方案评审，在 deep-research 与 SWE-bench Verified 上超过 ReAct 和 FoldAgent。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时回溯/验证/停止」的学习式决策、节点摘要式状态检查点与上下文压缩，可能为 LVR 的推理状态更新、证据筛选和停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但属纯文本 agent 场景，需确认能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态。
